name: go-like

scripts.verify: bun run fmt:check && bun run lint:check && bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun run test:unit:coverage
scripts.typecheck:root: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --pretty false && tsc -p tsconfig.tsdown.json --pretty false
scripts.typecheck:e2e: tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json --pretty false && tsc -p e2e/load/tsconfig.json --pretty false && tsc -p e2e/fixtures/published-consumer/tsconfig.authoring.json --pretty false
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:root && bun run typecheck:e2e && bun run --workspaces --sequential typecheck
scripts.test:unit: bun test --isolate --no-orphans test/*.test.ts && bun run --workspaces --sequential test:unit
scripts.test:unit:coverage: bun test --isolate --no-orphans test/*.test.ts --coverage && bun run --workspaces --sequential test:unit:coverage && bun run coverage:verify
scripts.test:e2e:suites: bun run build && bun e2e/run.ts --scope suites
scripts.test:e2e:providers: bun run build && bun e2e/run.ts --scope providers
scripts.test:e2e:runtimes: bun run build && bun e2e/run.ts --scope runtimes
scripts.test:e2e:examples: bun run build && bun e2e/run.ts --scope examples
scripts.test:e2e:published: bun run build && bun e2e/run.ts --scope published
scripts.test:e2e: bun run build && bun e2e/run.ts --scope all

description: go-like is a TypeScript monorepo for portable server lifecycle and request-handling primitives across Bun, Node.js, and Deno.
